scope: Automatic outpost construction recruitment, main-loop service, capital/slot admission and loaded withdrawal/refund for one home/source, plus native negative admission stages. Not whole ED-29 or RC qualification.
limitations: The positive fixture begins with no builder, but supplies a typed outpost lease and passive remote witness. Automatic scout/discovery/source selection is not exercised as a combined pipeline.
Initial funding is 1300 spawn/extension energy and 3000 storage; one 300-energy builder and four 300-energy plain roads are accounted separately. No mid-run resources or lifetimes are injected.
Returned home-funded construction energy is a refund, not remote income or profit. Native source extraction, reservation and broader startup/payback are not qualified by this construction trace.
One undamaged builder and plain route. Damage is rejected by unit health contracts; native threat/vision/replacement/alternate-home and contended handoff remain open.
CPU/Memory samples include probe overhead; the five-millisecond source-fleet regression is not ED-43 aggregate pressure or soak acceptance.
Road topology changes can leave non-current sites; selection fences them out, but stable route reuse/stale-site cleanup still needs assessment.
